server.name: io.github.ux-xd/dephealth
server.description: Package alive? Verdict with evidence: deprecated, archived, stale or active; plus runtime EOL dates.
server.title: Dependency Health MCP

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.not_for: Not a vulnerability scanner (advisory ids only, no CVSS triage or reachability), not license compliance, not a popularity ranking, and it cannot see private registries or vendored code.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.when_to_use: Before pinning, upgrading or auditing a dependency: package_health returns whether it is deprecated, archived, stale or active with the raw registry evidence, advisories for the version you use and the replacement if there is one; deps_audit does the same for a whole manifest; runtime_eol says whether a Node, Python, OS or database version is still supported and when it dies.

server.name: io.github.ux-xd/llms-txt
server.description: Any site's llms.txt: find the covering index, read its linked docs as markdown, search sections.
server.title: llms.txt for agents

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.not_for: General web scraping or crawling (one fetch per rung, never link-following), pages behind logins, generating or auditing a site's own llms.txt, or searching the whole web for documentation.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.when_to_use: The user needs a product's or library's own documentation and the site may publish llms.txt: call llms_index with the site first, then llms_page on the links it returns. Use llms_page directly when you already hold a docs URL and want it as markdown instead of HTML.

server.name: io.github.ux-xd/mcpfinder
server.description: Find an MCP server for any task: searches the official registry, Smithery and npm; remote-first.
server.title: MCP Finder

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.not_for: Calling the found server's tools (install it instead), or building a new MCP server.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.when_to_use: The user or agent needs a capability (an API, a data source, a SaaS action) and wants to know whether an MCP server already exists for it, which one is maintained and remote, and how to install it.

server.name: io.github.ux-xd/rss-feed
server.description: RSS, Atom and JSON feeds for agents: find a site's feed, read items as JSON, keyless news search.
server.title: RSS and news feeds for agents

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.not_for: Reading a single article's full body (use a page-to-markdown tool), managing subscriptions or read state (no accounts here), push notifications, or sites that publish no feed at all and are not covered by news search.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.when_to_use: The user wants what is new on a site or blog (feed_items with the site URL), needs a feed URL for a site that only shows HTML (feed_find), or asks what the news says about a topic (news_search). Use instead of scraping listing pages by hand.

server.name: io.github.ux-xd/wayback-machine
server.description: Wayback Machine for agents: closest archived copy of a URL with its text, and full capture history
server.title: Wayback Machine

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.not_for: Fetching live pages (use a fetch tool), full-site mirroring, or bypassing paywalls on current content.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.when_to_use: A page 404s, moved, was edited, or is behind a wall and you need what it said at a point in time; or you need every capture of a site or path (site archaeology: what a site ever had, when a page changed).
